v1.title: Gapless assembly of maize chromosomes using long-read technologies

v2.title: Conflicting Kinesin-14s in a single chromosomal drive haplotype
v2.reported_same_dna_statement: the v2 HiFi library used the same high molecular weight genomic DNA used in the B73-Ab10 v1 assembly
v2.reported_reference_limit: N-gaps occur predominantly within tandem-repeat arrays; the approximately 30.67-Mb Ab10 knob is about 28 percent assembled

v2_assembly.assembly_process: hifiasm 0.19.6 high-confidence contigs, half-depth filtering, RagTag scaffolding against Mo17 T2T
v2_assembly.truth_limit: not T2T or complete at the target knob arrays; assembled TR-1 and knob180 totals were reported slightly lower than v1

hifi_deposit.sra_design: HiFi library sequenced in CCS mode
hifi_deposit.public_object_state: original objects are split subreads BAM; ENA FASTQ is subreads rather than a published CCS product

eligibility_decision.primary_reason: the newer assembly is reported incomplete at the tandem arrays that would define collapse truth
eligibility_decision.secondary_reason: the public deposit does not expose a ready CCS-read product and the BioSample identifiers conflict despite the paper's same-DNA statement
eligibility_decision.why_no_execution: running TandemX cannot create valid labels when the proposed reference truth is explicitly incomplete
eligibility_decision.reopen_condition: obtain a demonstrably complete Ab10 array reference, resolve archival donor provenance and obtain validated CCS reads

evidence_boundary: source and reference eligibility audit only; no TandemX run, accuracy estimate or resource measurement
